record_title: Stability-targeted nonpairwise coupling collapses the synchrony-splay overlap
provenance: A source-specific stability refinement of the engineered nonpairwise Stuart-Landau phase model in arXiv:2609.20632v1: explicit synchrony and splay exponents identify a stability-matching strength distinct from the source's harmonic-cancellation strength.
limitations: The exact formulas concern the three-oscillator unweighted all-to-all second-order truncated phase model with straight isochrones and the source's engineered PN motifs. They do not establish exact global basin boundaries in the unreduced Stuart-Landau system or control omitted higher-order terms. Originality is qualified to the best of our knowledge.
